verdict.rationale: First-party marketing docs show QuickBooks Online imports bank and card transactions via bank feeds, reconciles bank statements, and auto-records and matches invoice payments. When reconciliation finishes it generates a report, and discrepancy, missing-check, and transaction-detail reports help surface mismatches for review. missing for 10: explicit evidence that duplicate transactions are detected or flagged, detailed documentation of the matched/unmatched review workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
